answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after verified work accumulates, so a hollow identity with no history cannot buy trust. Peers attest real completed tasks, and each attestation is weighted by the attester's own stake, so one bad actor standing on a narrow ledge of fake accounts cannot tip the scale. Every fake identity then costs more than it earns, and the loss ripples through the attacker's whole cluster instead of staying isolated.
